release_notes: Interactive onboarding walkthrough — learn every feature before your first dictation
Mic permission check at startup — no more silent failures if mic access is denied
RegisterHotKey replaces pynput — no longer flagged by antivirus as keylogger
Paste retry with error flash — no more silent data loss if paste fails
Onboarding walkthrough is smoother on Mac too, with better step order and clearer mode guidance
Mac now blocks onboarding until Accessibility and microphone permissions are properly granted
Mac microphone permission is requested before opening the audio stream, fixing silent zero-audio captures
Mac hotkey guidance now clearly rejects Caps Lock and explains Fn behavior for function keys
Mac release packaging is prepared with microphone usage metadata and audio-input entitlements
Cancel dictation mid-recording with the × button
Hotkey sound can now be toggled in Settings
Pill border color now reflects active mode (green / purple / blue)
